package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
)

type nextBestActionGetter interface {
	Execute(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherNextAction, error)
}

type NextBestActionHandler struct {
	Getter nextBestActionGetter
}

func (handler NextBestActionHandler) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	studentID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized")
		return
	}
	if r.URL.RawQuery != "" {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid next action request")
		return
	}
	if handler.Getter == nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "nba_state_unavailable")
		return
	}
	action, err := handler.Getter.Execute(r.Context(), studentID)
	switch {
	case err == nil:
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, action)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNextBestActionDisabled):
		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not found")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNextBestActionNotReady):
		writeError(w, http.StatusConflict, "nba_not_ready")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNextBestActionStateUnavailable):
		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "nba_state_unavailable")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest):
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid next action request")
	default:
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to resolve next action")
	}
}
